_comment: Pages of the RGD website that can open the chatbot with their context, as /assistant/chat?page=<key>&id=<id>.
label: how the page is named to the model and in the chat's context bar.
idKind: 'rgd' for a numeric RGD ID, 'accession' for an ontology accession such as DOID:9001309, 'none' for a page about no single record.
help: RGD website help articles for the page, by WordPress page ID; their chunks most relevant to the question are added to the context.
objectSuggestions: example questions when the page names a record ({name} is replaced by it); pageSuggestions: questions about the page itself.
